mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the brush into the body was the most worthwhile step: the description connected the brush, gears and hopper to how the finished sweeper would work. The project itself is more interesting than the individual fittings.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second wheel was repetitive. It contributed to the finished sweeper, but the individual action was routine.

surprise.text: The description explained that the wheel gear turns the brush gear the other way and the bristles flick crumbs into the hopper. That clarified how the sweeper is meant to work.

arbitrary.text: None of the parts seemed unnecessary for the sweeper, though choosing each instructed fitting felt mechanical rather than like a meaningful decision.

continue.text: I would not choose another chapter of the same assembly. The finished sweeper is appealing enough to understand, but fitting the parts one by one did not make me want to assemble more.
